transforms.code:
originalValues = self.custom.originalValues

	if (value['values']['assetPath'] or None) is None: return 'Line path not selected'
	if (value['values']['modeId'] or None) is None: return 'Event type not selected'
	if not system.date.isBefore(value['values']['startDate'], value['values']['endDate']): return 'Start must be before end'
	for key in value['values'].keys():
		if originalValues.has_key(key) and value['values'][key] != originalValues[key]:	break
	else:
		if not value['recurrence']['state'] in ['new', 'update', 'delete']: return 'No changes'
	
	return ''

if value['scheduleBlockId'] is None: return []
	return system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.schedule.getScheduleBlockExceptions({'scheduleBlockId': value['scheduleBlockId']}))

#	system.perspective.print("setting security for user %s"%(value['user']))
	
	secConfig = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.security.getConfig({}), 'configName', 'configValue')
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(value['user'])	
	userCRUD = system.kanoa.security.getUserAssetCRUD(userId)
	
	return {"userId": userId, "config": secConfig, "userCRUD": userCRUD}

scheduleBlockInfo = dict(value)
	
	scheduleBlockInfo['notes'] = scheduleBlockInfo['notes'] or ''
	scheduleBlockInfo['scheduleBlockName'] = scheduleBlockInfo['scheduleBlockName'] or ''
	scheduleBlockInfo['itemPath'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemPath', system.kanoa.item.getItems({'itemId': value['itemId']})) if value['itemId'] else None
	
	self.custom.originalValues = scheduleBlockInfo
	return scheduleBlockInfo

parentPath = value or ''	
	data = system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': parentPath + '%', 'assetTypeName': 'line'})
	dropInfo = {'drop': parentPath} if system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('oeeEnabled', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': parentPath})) == False else {}
	return [{'value': row['assetId'], 'label': system.kanoa.utilities.formatPath(row['assetPath'], dropInfo)} for row in data]
return [{"value": row['modeId'], "label": row['modeName']} for row in system.kanoa.asset.getAssetModes({'assetId': value['assetId'] or -1, 'enabled': True, 'canSchedule': True})]

onChange.script:
#	system.perspective.print("modeId changes %s"%origin)
	if origin == 'Browser':
		modeId = currentValue.value
		modeData = system.kanoa.asset.getModes({'modeId': modeId or -1})
		self.view.custom.values.color = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('modeColor', modeData) or '--kcGray-10'
		self.view.custom.values.modeName = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('modeName', modeData)
		if modeId is None:
			self.view.custom.values.workOrderId = None
			self.view.custom.values.workOrderName = None
			self.view.custom.values.itemId = None
	
	return

transforms.code:
if (value or None) is None: return '#D5D5D5'
	return system.kanoa.utilities.getContrastingColor(value)

itemIdList = list(set([row['itemId'] for row in system.kanoa.item.getAssetItems({'assetPath': value['assetPath'], 'enabled': True})]))
	orders = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrders({'itemIdList': itemIdList, 'isActive' : True, 'ignoreActualQty': True}), 'workOrderId', None)

	options = []
	for k,v in orders.items():
		label = "%s - %s (%s)"%(v['workOrderTitle'], v['itemName'], v['itemDescription']) if v['itemDescription'] else "%s - %s"%(v['workOrderName'], v['itemName'])
		options.append({"value": k, "label": label})
	
	return options

onChange.script:
if origin == 'Browser':
		workOrderId = currentValue.value
		if workOrderId is None: 
			self.view.custom.values.itemId = None
			self.view.custom.values.itemName = None
			self.view.custom.values.itemPath = None
			self.view.custom.values.scheduledQty = None
			return
			
		woData = system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrders({'workOrderId':workOrderId})
		if woData.rowCount > 0:
			self.view.custom.values.itemId = woData.getValueAt(0, 'itemId')
			self.view.custom.values.itemName = woData.getValueAt(0, 'itemName')
			self.view.custom.values.itemPath = woData.getValueAt(0, 'itemPath')
			self.view.custom.values.scheduledQty = woData.getValueAt(0, 'reqdQty') or 0.0 - woData.getValueAt(0, 'schedQty')
			self.view.custom.values.rruleStr = None
	
	return

customMethods.name: save
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("save() called")
	scheduleBlockInfo = dict(self.view.custom.values)
	recurrenceChangeType = self.view.custom.recurrence.changeType
	if scheduleBlockInfo['workOrderId']: scheduleBlockInfo['rruleStr'] = None	#Can't repeat a workorder run
	
	eventInfo = {'scheduleBlockInfo': scheduleBlockInfo, 'changeType': recurrenceChangeType, 'start': self.view.custom.dates.start, 'end': self.view.custom.dates.end}
		
	if scheduleBlockInfo['scheduleBlockId'] is None: system.perspective.sendMessage("createEvent", eventInfo) #add event
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage("adjustEvent", eventInfo) #Update existing event
	
	system.perspective.closePopup('')
	
	return

customMethods.name: deleteExceptions
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print('deleteExceptions()called')
	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	
	for exception in self.view.custom.exceptions.selection.data:
		system.kanoa.schedule.deleteScheduleBlockException(exception['scheduleBlockExceptionId'], userId)
		
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.exceptions.data")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("exceptionsUpdated")
		
	return

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print('updateRecurringOption() msg rcvd with %s'%payload)
	self.view.custom.recurrence.state = 'update' if (payload['uuid'] or None) is not None else 'new'
	if (self.view.custom.values.rruleStr or None) is None and (payload['rruleStr'] or None) is not None: 
		self.view.custom.recurrence.changeType = 'All events'	#prevents recurrencePopup from being displayed when we are changing a non recurring event to a recurring event
		
	self.view.custom.values.rruleStr = payload['rruleStr']
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.display.currentTab")
	
	return

system.perspective.print('editRecurringEvent() msg rcvd with %s'%payload)	
	self.view.custom.recurrence.changeType = payload['selectedOption']
	self.save()
	
	return

system.perspective.print("itemSelected() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	if len(payload['selection']) > 0:
		v = payload['selection'][0]['value']
		self.view.custom.values.itemId = v['itemId']
		self.view.custom.values.itemName = v['itemName']
		self.view.custom.values.itemPath = v['path']
	else:
		self.view.custom.values.itemId = None
		self.view.custom.values.itemName = None
		self.view.custom.values.itemPath = None

	return
